# Dolos

> Dolos is a lightweight Cardano data node written in Rust. It syncs the chain from a Cardano relay, keeps the ledger state, and serves it through Blockfrost-compatible HTTP (Mini-Blockfrost), UTxO RPC over gRPC, Cardano's node-to-client Ouroboros protocols on a local socket (which Ogmios and cardano-cli can use), a Kupo-compatible HTTP API (Mini-Kupo) and a Tx3 transaction resolver (TRP), without running a full node.

Dolos is configured with one TOML file (`dolos.toml`) and run with the `dolos` CLI. A new node either syncs from genesis or is bootstrapped from a Stelae snapshot, Mithril or a local ImmutableDB. Each API is enabled by its own `[serve.*]` table in the configuration.

## Getting started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos): from zero to a running instance, with install, `dolos init`, `dolos bootstrap` and `dolos daemon`
- [What is Dolos](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/what): what Dolos does, its API surface and its resource profile
- [Installation](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/installation): the available installation methods
- [Binary releases](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/installation/binaries): the install scripts, Homebrew, npm and prebuilt downloads
- [Docker](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/installation/docker): running Dolos from the container image
- [From source](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/installation/source): building with Cargo

## Configuration

- [Configuration introduction](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/configuration/introduction): where the TOML file is read from, environment overrides and validation
- [Configuration schema](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/configuration/schema): every section and field, including the `[serve.*]` tables that enable each API
- [Bootstrap](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/bootstrap): filling the stores from a Stelae snapshot (minutes), Mithril or a local ImmutableDB (hours) instead of syncing from genesis
- [Mithril bootstrap](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/bootstrap/mithril): bootstrapping from a Mithril-certified ImmutableDB
- [Local ImmutableDB bootstrap](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/bootstrap/local): bootstrapping from a local Cardano node database

## APIs

- [Mini-Blockfrost](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/apis/minibf): Blockfrost-compatible HTTP API, so existing Blockfrost clients and SDKs can point at Dolos
- [UTxO RPC](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/apis/grpc): gRPC endpoint following the UTxO RPC spec for queries, chain following and transaction submission
- [Ouroboros](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/apis/ouroboros): node-to-client mini-protocols on a Unix socket, for Ogmios, cardano-cli and other tools that expect a Cardano node
- [Mini-Kupo](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/apis/minikupo): read-only, Kupo-compatible HTTP API for pattern matches, datums, scripts and metadata

## Integrations

- [UTxO RPC client guide](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/integrations/utxorpc): streaming filtered transactions with WatchTx
- [Tx3](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/integrations/tx3): using the built-in TRP server to resolve Tx3 transaction templates
- [Blaze](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/integrations/blaze): using Dolos as the UTxO RPC provider for the Blaze JavaScript SDK

## Operations

- [Operations](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/operations): running and operating an instance
- [Operation modes](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/operations/modes): `daemon` (sync and serve), `sync catchup` (sync to the upstream tip and exit, or keep following with `--follow`) and `serve` (serve only)
- [Logging](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/operations/logging): log levels and output
- [Tracing](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/operations/tracing): exporting OpenTelemetry traces
- [Performance](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/operations/performance): expected sync time, resource use and query latency, with practical guidance
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/operations/troubleshooting): the warning and error codes Dolos logs, and how to act on each

- [Architecture overview](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/architecture): how the sync pipeline, ledger, storage and serving layers fit together
- [Serving layer](https://docs.txpipe.io/dolos/architecture/serving-layer): how the APIs are built on the stores
- [Source repository](https://github.com/txpipe/dolos): code, issues and the changelog
- [Releases](https://github.com/txpipe/dolos/releases): release notes and binaries
